text:
Stop agents from starting commands they cannot read back. In the PreToolUse hook (crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs), deny a Bash call that sets run_in_background, with a message saying to run the command in the foreground because its output file would be outside the working directory. Add one line to the producer and verifier briefs that background runs are not available. Add a policy test for the denial. Evidence: Read denials on Claude Code task output files appear in 30 producer invocations; job 20261031-043143-vbee made no change because of it.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Producers run commands in the background, then are denied reading the output file outside their working directory, and some end with no change
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs
